title: Cozy Survival
description: This modpack aims to add lots of Vanilla QoL Features
body:
Cozy Survival
- 
Cozy Survival is a Fabric modpack that brings lots of QoL features to Minecraft, without drastically changing much of your vanilla survival gameplay.

It features:

• Smooth chunk rendering by means of "Chunks fade in"

• Easier to read f3 menu with "Clean F3"

• Trailer like animations for mobs and players with the help of the "fresh animations" and "Detailed animtations" reasource packs

• No nether fog with the "No fog" mod

• See Coordinates without have to open the F3 menu with the "Coordinates Display" mod

• Many performance mods

• And many more QoL mods
~~~~
This modpack is still being devolped so more features will be added in the future!
